concept.title: Set Up Securities for Caps and Floors
concept.shortdesc: This topic explains how to establish cap and floor security records and configure coupon settings.

conbody.p: You can use the Reference Data Center to establish a cap or floor Security Master File (SMF) record with the Cap - Floor data strategy. Alternatively, you can use the Accounting Center's Issue Viewer. Use the Caps & Floors panel to set up a cap or floor security.

section.title: Caps and Floors Key Options
section.p: A cap or floor must adhere to the same requirements as all fixed income securities. The First Coupon Date, Last Coupon Date, and Maturity Date values must not include Delay Days.

section.title: Coupon Setup for Caps and Floors
section.p: When you use the Caps & Floors panel, you must specify a Coupon Type (tag 97). supports Variable Rate, Unscheduled Variable Rate, Floating Rate, and Inverse Floating Rate. For Floating and Inverse Floating rates, the system requires specific underlying security fields.

section.title: Cap Coupon Rate Example
section.p: In this example, a Cap Security has a Strike Rate of 8%, LIBOR as the underlying index, and an Index Offset of 250 basis points. On January 1, compares the All in Rate (8.5%) against the Strike Price (8%). Because the All in Rate exceeds the Strike Price, accrues the difference (0.5%). In subsequent quarters, if rates do not exceed the Strike Rate, accrues at a Coupon Rate of 0.00%.
